text:
mike_cs: FYI SilverWing Learning asked for a one-day capacity boost for a public demo next week — need temporary QPS bump + region peering + CIDR allowlist. Can infra enable?

emily_infra: quick q: exact time window and CIDR ranges? region routing or just egress peering? Also what spike profile (p95/p99 tokens) so we size correctly.

mike_cs: timeframe they requested: 2026-04-10 09:00-18:00 UTC (single business-day demo). CIDRs provided by their network team: 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/25. Expected spike: sustained ~12k qps for ~2 hours peak, baseline ~800 qps rest of day. They want low latency across APAC + EU — prefer peered egress + region routing. Customer text: "demo to ~500 schools, interactive chat, low-latency required".

sophia_sales: heads-up — SilverWing renewal in ~45 days and this demo is high-stakes. Recommend we approve but enforce auto-revoke and canary. Sales can commit to cover any short-term overage if needed.

jacob_eng: doable from serving side. My plan: set a temporary rate-window + allowlist + fallback model policy so we don't blackhole requests if upstream saturates. Proposed config snippet (canary in eu-west-1 first):
```
routes:
  - regions: [eu, apac]
    qps_limit: 12000
    allowlist: ["203.0.113.0/24", "198.51.100.0/25"]
    fallback_model: model-rw-small
    canary: eu-west-1
    auto_revoke: 24h
```
This keeps main model but drops to smaller model on overload; logs and tracing will show fallback events.

emily_infra: I can apply the peering + allowlist. Need: exact org id + billing contact + SSO admin consent for peering. Also confirm whether to spin up dedicated capacity or use burst pool. Can you open a support ticket with the details?

mike_cs: org id: `org-9845`, billing: billing@silverwing.org, SSO admin: ops@silverwing.org. I'll open the ticket and add expected traffic shape + contact on-call during demo.

nora_support: I'll prepare an enablement doc for SilverWing ops: short runbook on fallback model behavior, where to see latency/throughput in Console, and how to request emergency lift. Also will schedule a health check 12h after the demo to capture feedback + any regression in quality.

emily_infra: started canary in eu-west-1 now. will roll to apac on green. Applying allowlist and rate-window. tagging config with KMS key per enterprise policy. ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: config update initiated by @emily_infra at 3162223450. action: apply-route-change(canary=eu-west-1) — logs: https://internal.redwood/deploys/3162223450 

emily_infra: canary looks green (no 5xx, p95 latency stable). rolling to apac edge now. audit entry created.

deploy-bot: roll complete at 3162223505. changed routes for org-9845: qps=12000, allowlisted CIDRs added, fallback-model=model-rw-small, auto_revoke=24h.

mike_cs: amazing, thanks. Emily — confirm revert schedule and post the audit link so I can update the customer that this is timeboxed and will auto-revoke. :thumbsup: 

emily_infra: auto-revoke scheduled for 2026-04-11 09:00 UTC. audit: https://redwood-internal/audit/3162223450. Will also tag the change with renewal-case:SW-9845.

mike_cs: I'll notify SilverWing ops and mention the canary + auto-revoke. Nora — please run the post-demo quality checklist and capture any feedback (model drift, latency spikes, UI errors).

nora_support: on it. I'll attach the checklist in the support ticket and set a reminder for the 12h health check.

sophia_sales: adding this thread to the renewal playbook; will follow up with SilverWing exec post-demo. Good cross-org response, thanks team. :rocket:

mike_cs: closing thread here after audit captured. if any emergency, ping #eng-oncall and tag me.
